issues.issue: Which new documents are admissible (three Memurlar.net articles, updated NDP, RAD decisions)?
issues.applicant_position: Submits four post-decision documents: three Memurlar.net articles and an updated NDP.
issues.result_text: Three Memurlar.net articles admitted; updated NDP and RAD decisions not admitted.

issues.issue: Should an oral hearing be held?
issues.applicant_position: Does not request an oral hearing.
issues.result_text: No oral hearing; no serious credibility issue raised by new evidence.

issues.issue: Does the Appellant face a forward-looking reasonable chance of persecution as a perceived XXXX supporter or former cadet?
issues.applicant_position: RPD wrongly found only a 'chance'; objective evidence shows cadets are targeted and blacklisted.
issues.result_text: Well-founded fear of persecution established given blacklisting, arrests and sustained rights violations.

issues.issue: Are state protection or an internal flight alternative available in Turkey?
issues.result_text: No state protection or IFA; the state is the agent of harm throughout the country.
